title: EPUB generator tests exercise a stale helper instead of production code

evidence.quote: Creates a test book mimicking EpubGenerator's createBook logic.

reasoning: The test suite constructs its own Book with briefing/deep-dive sections, while production EpubGenerator now groups by feed and has private sanitizer/file-writing behavior. These tests can pass while the production generator has broken TOC structure, sanitizer behavior, metadata formatting, or resource output.
recommendation: Refactor EpubGenerator so book creation and sanitization can be tested directly, or instantiate the production generator with testable file/output abstractions. Update expectations to the current feed-chapter behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The gap is the finding: the tests duplicate old generation logic instead of calling the production implementation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Replace helper-based tests with tests against production book-building/sanitization logic, including feed grouping, escaped titles, sanitized content, and readable EPUB output.
minimumFixScope: EpubGenerator test structure and any small production seams needed to test book creation without Android public-storage I/O.
